answer: Admission uses commit-reveal escrow tied to a future beacon. Each applicant hashes a secret and posts a 0.40-unit escrow, adding one vertex to the admission graph. At epoch N+2 the nebula VRF beacon samples 5 percent of applicants; sampled agents reveal the preimage and pass one benchmark job, e.g. routing timber shipments. Missed or wrong reveals forfeit escrow; correct ones release it plus 0.05 units. An attacker with 100 identities locks 40.00 units for 2 epochs but expects 5 reveals, so 95 forfeit 38.00 units per cycle. Reused secrets forfeit all.
